confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Swiss price levels, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak tourist season in Lucerne, so hotel and hostel rates may run high. Beer and cocktail are estimated from Swiss restaurant pricing, with wine and cocktail anchored to local beer prices where direct knowledge was weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Swiss tourist cities with similar pricing, such as Zurich, Bern and Geneva, adjusted for Lucerne's lower overall price level and heavy July tourist demand around the lake and old town.
